string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER_SCROLL_START_KIT_01_DESC
string.body: There is no resurrection penalty or XP loss when killed. Flying/Teleporting/Returning to Bind Point costs only 1 Kinah.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER_XP_BOOST_50_DESC
string.body: Grants you 50%% additional EXP from gathering, crafting, or hunting.\nThe effect expires after 30 minutes and there is a 30 minute cooldown before you can use it again.\nAffects all party members.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER_GATHER_BOOST_200_DESC
string.body: This effect increases your acquisition of gathering, extraction, and Aether extraction skills by 200%%. \nThis effect expires after 30 minutes, and there is a 30 minute cooldown before you can use it again.\nWhen used, it affects every member in your party.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER_AP_BOOST_30_DESC
string.body: Grants you 30%% additional Abyss Points from PvE and PvP kills. However, this item doesn't apply to rewards received from the Dredgion or the Empyrean Crucible.\nExpires after 30 minutes, and there is a 30 minute cooldown before you can use it again.\nAffects all party members.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER_CRAFT_BOOST_200_DESC
string.body: This effect increases your acquisition of crafting and furniture crafting skills by 200%%.\nThe effect expires after 30 minutes and there is a 30 minute cooldown before you can use it again.\nWhen used, it affects every member in the group.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_WINTER_DROP_BOOST_20_DESC
string.body: This effect increases your item drop rate by 20%% when hunting creatures.\nThe effect expires after 30 minutes and there is a 30 minute cooldown before you can use it again.\nWhen used, it affects every member in your party.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_STUN_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with a 7%% chance to stun a target for 1 second. There is a chance that the godstone will be destroyed when the effect is triggered.\nDouble-click to activate, and then select an item to socket.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_PARALYZE_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with an effect where there is a 3%% chance to paralyze a target for 4 seconds. There is a chance that the godstone will be destroyed when the effect is triggered.\nDouble-click to activate, and then select an item to socket.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_ROOT_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with an effect where there is a 3%% chance to immobilize a target for 10 seconds. There is a chance that the godstone will be destroyed when the effect is triggered.\nDouble-click to activate, and then select an item to socket.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_SILENCE_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with an effect where there is a 6%% chance to silence a target for 7 seconds. There is a chance that the godstone will be destroyed when the effect is triggered.\nDouble-click to activate, and then select an item to socket.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_BLIND_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with an effect where there is a 6%% chance to blind a target for 8 seconds. There is a chance that the godstone will be destroyed when the effect is triggered.\nDouble-click to activate, and then select an item to socket.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_SLOW_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with an effect where there is a 6%% chance to reduce a target's attack speed by 50%% for 10 seconds. There is a chance that the godstone will be destroyed when the effect is triggered.\nDouble-click to activate, and then select an item to socket.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_SNARE_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with an effect where there is a 6%% chance to reduce a target's movement speed by 50%% for 10 seconds. There is a chance that the godstone will be destroyed when the effect is triggered.\nDouble-click to activate, and then select an item to socket.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_POISON_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with an 11%% chance to inflict an additional 52 poison damage per 2 seconds for 20 seconds. There is a chance that the godstone will be destroyed when the effect is triggered.\nDouble-click to activate, and then select an item to socket.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_BLEED_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with an effect where there is a 9%% chance to inflict an additional 95 bleeding damage per 2 seconds for 10 seconds. There is a chance that the godstone will be destroyed when the effect is triggered.\nDouble-click to activate, and then select an item to socket.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_FIRE_DAMAGE_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with an 11%% chance to inflict an additional 552 fire damage. There is a chance that the godstone will be destroyed when the effect is triggered.\nDouble-click to activate, and then select an item to socket.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_WATER_DAMAGE_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with a 21%% chance to inflict an additional 269 water damage. There is a chance that the godstone will be destroyed when the effect is triggered.\nDouble-click to activate, and then select an item to socket.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_EARTH_DAMAGE_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with an 11%% chance to inflict an additional 552 earth damage. There is a chance that the godstone will be destroyed when the effect is triggered.\nDouble-click to activate, and then select an item to socket.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_AIR_DAMAGE_U1_65A_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with a 21%% chance to inflict an additional 269 wind damage. There is a chance that the godstone will be destroyed when the effect is triggered.\nDouble-click to activate, and then select an item to socket.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_FIRE_DAMAGE_U1_65B_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with a 2%% chance to inflict an additional 3640 fire damage. There is a chance that the godstone will be destroyed when the effect is triggered.\nDouble-click to activate, and then select an item to socket.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_WATER_DAMAGE_U1_65B_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with an effect where there is a 3%% chance to inflict an additional 1880 water damage. There is a chance that the godstone will be destroyed when the effect is triggered.\nDouble-click to activate, and then select an item to socket.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_EARTH_DAMAGE_U1_65B_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with a 2%% chance to inflict 3640 earth damage, and chance of being destroyed upon trigger.\nDouble-click to activate, and then select an item to socket.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_PROC_AIR_DAMAGE_U1_65B_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with an effect that has a 3%% chance to inflict 1880 wind damage, and chance of being destroyed upon trigger.\nDouble-click to activate, and then select an item to socket.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_ACCURACY_70D_DESC
string.body: Increases Accuracy by 35 when equipped in the item's manastone stocketing slot.\nClick on the ancient manastone and select [Use] or double-click (right-click) to then select the item and socket the manastone.\nCannot be socketed on exclusive Archdaeva equipment.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_DODGE_70D_DESC
string.body: Increases Evasion by 24 when equipped in the item's manastone stocketing slot.\nClick on the ancient manastone and select [Use] or double-click (right-click) to then select the item and socket the manastone.\nCannot be socketed on exclusive Archdaeva equipment.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_PCRITICAL_70D_DESC
string.body: Increases Physical Critical Hit by 24 when equipped in the item's manastone stocketing slot.\nClick on the ancient manastone and select [Use] or double-click (right-click) to then select the item and socket the manastone.\nCannot be socketed on exclusive Archdaeva equipment.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_MAGICALCRITICAL_70D_DESC
string.body: Increases Magic Critical Hit by 9 when equipped in the item's manastone stocketing slot.\nClick on the ancient manastone and select [Use] or double-click (right-click) to then select the item and socket the manastone.\nCannot be socketed on exclusive Archdaeva equipment.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_MAGICALCRITICALREDUCERATE_70D_DESC
string.body: Increases Critical Hit Resistance by 11 when equipped in the item's manastone stocketing slot.\nClick on the ancient manastone and select [Use] or double-click (right-click) to then select the item and socket the manastone.\nCannot be socketed on exclusive Archdaeva equipment.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_PHYSICALDEFEND_70D_DESC
string.body: Increases Physical Defense by 100 when equipped in the item's manastone stocketing slot.\nClick on the ancient manastone and select [Use] or double-click (right-click) to then select the item and socket the manastone.\nCannot be socketed on exclusive Archdaeva equipment.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_MRESIST_70D_DESC

string.name: STR_LOGIN_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_PATTACK_70D_DESC
string.body: Increases Weapon Damage by 8 when socketed an item's manastone slot.\nClick the ancient manastone and select [Select] or double-click (or right-cick) to select an item to socket.\nYou cannot socket it in High Daeva-only equipment.

string.name: STR_LOGIN_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_MACCURACY_70D_DESC

string.name: STR_LOGIN_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_MAGICALSKILLBOOSTRESIST_70D_DESC

string.name: STR_LOGIN_SPECIAL_MATTER_OPTION_HEALSKILLBOOST_70D_DESC

string.name: STR_LOGIN_MATTER_OPTION_L_PATTACK_HP_60_DESC
string.body: Increases Weapon Damage by 5 and HP by 47 when socketed in an item's manastone slot.\nDouble-click (or right-click) the manastone to activate it, and select the item you wish to socket.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_KISK_LIGHT_PRIVATE_SMALL_DESC
string.body: Summons a Kisk that allows you to resurrect at the installation site. It lasts for 2 hours and can be reinstalled after a 30 minute cooldown.\nIt can only be used by the summoner.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_KISK_LIGHT_PARTY_SMALL_DESC
string.body: Summons a Kisk where you can resurrect from. It lasts for 2 hours and allows the registration of up to 6 people.\nOnly the members of the summoner's group can use it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_KISK_LIGHT_FORCE_MEDIUM_DESC
string.body: Summons a Kisk where you can resurrect from. It lasts for 2 hours and allows the registration of up to 24 people.\nIt can only be used by the members of the summoner's Force.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_KISK_LIGHT_LEGION_LARGE_DESC

string.name: STR_WRAP_COIN_NAMED_CRAFT_01
string.body: High Grade Crafting Material Box of Conquest

string.name: STR_RIDE_COIN_NAMED_CRESTLICH_001_DESC
string.body: Use this to get on board / to get off.

string.name: STR_RIDE_COIN_NAMED_BIKE_001_DESC
string.body: Use this to get on/off.\nPress and hold the Vertical Ascent key to activate/maintain the Sprint effect.\nIt consumes your Flight Time.

string.name: STR_RIDE_COIN_NAMED_PAGATI_001_DESC
string.body: Use this to get on/off.\nPress and hold the Vertical Ascent key to activate/maintain the Sprint effect.\nIt consumes your Flight Time.

string.name: STR_COIN_NAMED_02_DESC
string.body: An Honorable Conqueror's Mark. \nUsed to purchase Bundles of Honor and Conquest from the Conqueror's Mark Exchanger.

string.name: STR_WRAP_COIN_NAMED_RIDE_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing a mount that can be purchased with Conqueror's Marks.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to open it.

string.name: STR_WRAP_COIN_NAMED_CRAFT_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing high grade craft materials.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to open it.

string.name: STR_WRAP_COIN_NAMED_WING_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing a Wing Feather that can be purchased with Conqueror's Marks.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to open it.

string.name: STR_WRAP_COIN_NAMED_DROP_LF4_01_DESC
string.body: A box of Inggison Low Grade Conqueror's Marks.\n It contains Conqueror's Marks and the Asmodians have a low chance of additionally obtaining Blood Marks.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to check its contents.

string.name: STR_WRAP_COIN_NAMED_DROP_LF4_02_DESC
string.body: A box of Inggison Middle Grade Conqueror's Marks.\nIt contains Conqueror's Marks and the Asmodians have a low chance of additionally obtaining Blood Marks.\n Double-click (or right-click) to check its contents.

string.name: STR_WRAP_COIN_NAMED_DROP_LF4_03_DESC
string.body: A box of Inggison High Grade Conqueror's Marks.\n It contains Conqueror's Marks and the Asmodians have a low chance of additionally obtaining Blood Marks.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to check its contents.

string.name: STR_WRAP_COIN_NAMED_DROP_DF4_01_DESC
string.body: A box of Gelkmaros Low Grade Conqueror's Marks.\n It contains Conqueror's Marks and the Elyos have a low chance of additionally obtaining Blood Marks.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to check its contents.

string.name: STR_WRAP_COIN_NAMED_DROP_DF4_02_DESC
string.body: A box of Gelkmaros Middle Grade Conqueror's Marks.\n It contains Conqueror's Marks and the Elyos have a low chance of additionally obtaining Blood Marks.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to check its contents.

string.name: STR_WRAP_COIN_NAMED_DROP_DF4_03_DESC
string.body: A box of Gelkmaros High Grade Conqueror's Marks.\n It contains Conqueror's Marks and the Elyos have a low chance of additionally obtaining Blood Marks.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to check its contents.

string.name: STR_WRAP_COIN_NAMED_COIN_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing 1 to 100 Conqueror's Marks.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to open it.

string.name: STR_STIGMA_N_FI_BURSERKLANCE_G1_DESC
string.body: Place this stone in a Greater Stigma slot.\nWhen equipped, it allows you to use the Sure Strike skill.\nYou can equip/enhance it through a Stigma Master or double-click to equip. Can be enchanted with a Stigma Enchantment Stone or an identical Stigma.

string.body: Place this stone in a Greater Stigma slot.\nWhen equipped, it allows you to use the Spite Strike skill.\nYou can equip/enhance it through a Stigma Master or double-click to equip. Can be enchanted with a Stigma Enchantment Stone or an identical Stigma.

Use this to get on/off.
Press and hold the Vertical Ascent key to activate/maintain the mount's Sprint.
It consumes your Flight Time.
Available for 7 days.

string.name: STR_WRAP_SPECIAL_WORLDRAID_REWARD_51A_DESC
string.body: An Abyssal Reward Box from Beritra's Invasion.\nThere is a chance to obtain equipment or consumables from this reward box.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_PACK_AC_M_50A
string.body: Specialized Wrapping Scroll for Mythic Class - Accessory and Head Armor

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_PACK_WE_M_50A_DESC
string.body: This scroll can be used on a wrappable Mythic weapon of Level 50 or below.\nThe weapon can be traded once after the wrapping.\nDouble-click and select the item that you want to wrap.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_PACK_AR_M_50A_DESC
string.body: This scroll can be used on a wrappable Mythic armor piece of Level 50 or below.\nThe piece of armor can be traded once after the wrapping.\nDouble-click and select the item that you want to wrap.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_PACK_AC_M_50A_DESC
string.body: This scroll can be used on a wrappable Mythic class Accessory and Head Armor that is Level 50 or lower.\nThe armor can be traded just once after wrapping.\nDouble-click (or right-click) the Wrapping Scroll (Accessory and Head Armor) and select the item that you want to wrap.

string.name: STR_EVENT_FOOD_SHEEP_CANDY_01_DESC
string.body: You transform into a Sheep that can use skills for 60 minutes. Meanwhile, your [%e2.StatUp.StatName] and [%e2.StatUp.StatName2] increase by [%e2.StatUp.Value] and [%e2.StatUp.Value2] points respectively, and your [%e3.StatUp.StatName] and [%e3.StatUp.StatName2] increase by [%e3.StatUp.Value]%% and [%e3.StatUp.Value2]%% respectively.

string.body: You transform into an Sheep that can use skills for 60 minutes. Meanwhile, your [%e2.StatUp.StatName] increases by [%e2.StatUp.Value] and [%e2.StatUp.StatName2] increases by [%e2.StatUp.Value2]. Additionally, your [%e3.StatUp.StatName] increases by [%e3.StatUp.Value]%% and [%e3.StatUp.Value2]%% increases by [%e3.StatUp.StatName2].

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MATRYOSHKA_SCROLL_START_KIT_01_DESC
string.body: While this effect lasts, there is no resurrection penalty or XP loss when killed and Flying/Teleporting/Returning to Bind Point costs only 1 Kinah.\nWhen used, it affects every member in your group.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MATRYOSHKA_XP_BOOST_50_DESC
string.body: The effect grants you 50%% additional EXP from gathering, crafting, or hunting creatures. \nThe effect expires after 30 minutes and there is a 30 minute cooldown before you can use it again.\nWhen used, it affects every member in your party.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MATRYOSHKA_GATHER_BOOST_200_DESC
string.body: This effect increases your acquisition of gathering, extraction, and Aether extraction skills by 200%%. \nThis effect expires after 30 minutes, and there is a 30 minute cooldown before you can use it again.\nWhen used, it affects every member in your party.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MATRYOSHKA_AP_BOOST_30_DESC
string.body: Grants you 30%% additional Abyss Points from PvE and PvP kills. However, this item doesn't apply to rewards received from the Dredgion or the Empyrean Crucible.\nExpires after 30 minutes, and there is a 30 minute cooldown before you can use it again.\nAffects all party members.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MATRYOSHKA_CRAFT_BOOST_200_DESC
string.body: This effect increases your acquisition of crafting and furniture crafting skills by 200%%.\nThe effect expires after 30 minutes and there is a 30 minute cooldown before you can use it again.\nWhen used, it affects every member in the group.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MATRYOSHKA_DROP_BOOST_20_DESC
string.body: This effect increases your item drop rate by 20%% when hunting creatures.\nThe effect expires after 30 minutes and there is a 30 minute cooldown before you can use it again.\nWhen used, it affects every member in your party.

string.name: STR_CASH_ITEM_L_IDDFLAME_POLYMORPH_KNIGHT_DESC
string.body: A ticket that summons the Smoldering Fire Temple Spirit, Stomper. The summoned spirit transforms you into Stomper.\nIf the transformation wears off at the Smoldering Fire Temple, use it again for transformation.\nThe summoned soul is available only to an individual player and stays for 2 hours.

string.body: An Aether Cherry of mysterious colors. Daevas don't eat it because it's bitter, but certain pets gain tireless energy from it.

string.name: STR_EVENT_PETCARD_BUFF_ATK_SHUGHOST_01_DESC
string.body:
A Fervent Shugost's egg.
It automatically uses cooking and magic items.
When fed an Aether Cherry, it boosts its master's attack stats.
You can obtain it from a Pet Distributor.
You can keep the parceled pet for 30 days.

string.name: STR_EVENT_PETCARD_BUFF_DEF_SHUGHOST_01_DESC
string.body:
A Calm Shugost's egg.
It automatically uses cooking and magic items.
When fed an Aether Cherry, it boosts its master's defense stats.
You can obtain it from a Pet Distributor.
You can keep the parceled pet for 30 days.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_MIDAUTUMN_YUEBING_DESC
string.body: This is a Mooncake Set. Bring it to Ring to obtain a reward.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_MIDAUTUMN_TREASURE_DESC
string.body: A reward that contains Ring's warm heart.\nDouble-click (or right-click) it to check its contents.

string.name: STR_AB1_HIGH_TYPE_E_LIMIT_DESC
string.body: Deals 3%% additional damage to iceclad-type targets.

string.name: STR_TEST_FOOD_CANDY_FX_DESC
string.body: You transform for 60 minutes; your [%e1.StatUp.StatName]% and [%e1.StatUp.StatName2]% increase by [%e1.StatUp.Value] and [%e1.StatUp.Value2] points respectively, and your [%e2.StatUp.StatName]% and [%e2.StatUp.StatName2]% increase by [%e2.StatUp.Value]%% and [%e2.StatUp.Value2]%% respectively.

string.name: STR_CASH_RIDE_ROCKET_02_ALL_DESC

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_STUN_U2_70A_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with an 8%% chance to stun a target for 1 second. The godstone will be destroyed when the buff effect is ends.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to activate, then select an item in which to socket the godstone.

string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_PARALYZE_U2_70A_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with a 4%% chance to paralyze a target for 4 seconds. There is a small chance the godstone will be destroyed upon triggering its effect.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to activate, then select an item in which to socket the godstone.

It automatically uses cooking and magic items.

You can obtain it from a Pet Distributor.
You can keep the pet for 7 days.

string.name: STR_MATTER_ENCHANT_STIGMA_DESC
string.body:
You can enchant all applicable functions of the Stigma.
If successful, the level will increase by 1, with a lower chance of increasing by 2 or 3.
